_comment: Golden truth table for the SIMPLIFY clause's delta-scoped ratio boundary (DE-FR-SIMPLIFY-001, AC-1/AC-5). MATERIAL_SIMPLIFICATION_MAX_RATIO=0.50 is compared against overlay_node_count/replaced_cascade_node_count (NOT whole-tree counts). Calmar is held IDENTICAL between incumbent and candidate in every row (annualized_return/max_drawdown equal on both sides) so the SIMPLIFY tag's presence is driven purely by the ratio, isolating this clause from the IMPROVE path. incumbent_node_count/candidate_node_count (whole-tree) are deliberately set to a near-100%-of-incumbent value in every row to prove the OLD whole-tree comparison could never have produced these accept rows — only the new delta-scoped operands can.

rows.name: zero_overlay_node_count_declines_never_fabricates
rows._comment: 0 trivially satisfies the naive ratio (0 <= cascade*0.5) but must decline -- a genuine overlay can never be 0 nodes; 0 signals a counting failure, not a real candidate, and must be treated like None/absent.
